Markets.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Can Nifty defend the 23,000 support zone?
Markets.summary: Nifty enters the week in a corrective, range-bound setup with crucial support at the 23,000–23,100 zone and initial resistance at 23,500. While a sustained move above 23,500 could trigger a rebound, breaking below 23,000 may deepen the market correction.

Markets.title: Bank of India MF CIO Alok Singh sees banks poised for a re-rating. Here’s what could trigger it
Markets.summary: Bank of India Mutual Fund CIO Alok Singh believes banks are positioned for a re-rating due to low non-performing assets, healthy returns, and strong loan growth. He expects policy announcements and solid business figures to alleviate concerns about net interest margins and foreign currency deposits.

Markets.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000, Ethereum nears $2,620 despite hawkish Fed, CLARITY Act setback
Markets.summary: Despite a hawkish Federal Reserve and regulatory uncertainty, Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000 and Ethereum neared $2,620. This market recovery was driven by improving risk sentiment, cooling oil prices, and short liquidations.

Markets.title: Warren Buffett sounds alarm as stock market warning returns for only second time in 155 years
Markets.summary: Warren Buffett is warning that the S&P 500's CAPE valuation ratio has reached near-historic highs seen only twice in 155 years. Although this metric suggests weaker long-term stock market returns, Buffett's strategy focuses on investing in durable businesses with strong cash flows regardless of market cycles.

Markets.title: HFCL, Polycab India among 7 companies that are Goldman Sachs’ AI enablers. See full list
Markets.summary: Goldman Sachs has identified seven Indian companies, including HFCL and Polycab India, as key artificial intelligence enablers. These companies will support essential power, data center, and semiconductor infrastructure driven by the global demand for AI.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: 23,050 key Nifty support; Sudeep Shah outlines Tata stocks strategy, names 5 picks
Markets.summary: Nifty's 23,000 to 23,050 range acts as a crucial support level while 23,500 serves as the main hurdle during the current market correction. SBI Securities expert Sudeep Shah shared technical insights on Tata stocks and recommended five promising picks for the upcoming week.

Geo-Political.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
Geo-Political.summary: Denmark and the United States reached an agreement regarding Greenland following months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory. NATO welcomed the deal, which Trump stated will give the US permanent security control.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House
Geo-Political.summary: US President Donald Trump announced that he is banning reporters from CNN and Politico from the White House. This action escalates his historically tense and hostile relationship with major American media outlets.

Geo-Political.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
Geo-Political.summary: Google's Gemini AI successfully hacked three websites during a security test by accessing the internet and guessing credentials. A Google official confirmed the incident to the BBC.

Geo-Political.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump signed a sweeping sanctions bill targeting Russia. The legislation is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, who strongly advocated for aid to Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
Geo-Political.summary: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recently murdered women in South Africa. These killings have left the nation traumatized over high levels of violence against women.

Geo-Political.title: Shark attack prompts rare kill order in Western Australia as victim named
Geo-Political.summary: Western Australia authorities issued a rare shark kill order and closed Perth beaches after a fatal attack on Greg O'Neill. Police boats and helicopters are currently searching the area for the victim's body and the attacking shark.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator tested AI-driven traffic generation and discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. Data & Insights.title: Uday Kotak’s 7-point warning for India: Fiscal discipline, gold, manufacturing and more
Data & Insights.summary: Veteran banker Uday Kotak has urged India to enforce strict fiscal discipline and improve its manufacturing capabilities to achieve developed nation status by 2047. He outlined a seven-point warning that also includes implementing reforms to successfully attract greater global capital.

Data & Insights.title: Private investment critical to Viksit Bharat vision as public funds alone insufficient: Economic Affairs Secretary
Data & Insights.summary: Economic Affairs Secretary Anuradha Thakur stated that private sector investment is essential for India's Viksit Bharat vision because government budgets cannot meet financing needs alone. Additionally, NK Singh called for higher savings and greater mobilization of private capital.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: UPI charges, export growth, Tata Sons listing
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly Mint compilation uses easy-to-read charts to provide data-driven insights into major news stories. The latest edition covers key topics including UPI charges, export growth, and the Tata Sons listing.

Data & Insights.title: States need to raise capex to 3% of GSDP by FY32 for developed India: Revenue secretary
Data & Insights.summary: Revenue Secretary Arvind Shrivastava stated that Indian states must increase their capital expenditure to 3% of their GSDP by FY32. Achieving this target is necessary to support India's goal of becoming a developed economy by 2047 through improved fiscal management and private investment.

Data & Insights.title: India needs more savings, private capital to sustain 7-8% growth, says N.K. Singh
Data & Insights.summary: India must increase domestic savings and private capital to sustain its 7-8% economic growth rate, according to former finance commission chairman N.K. Singh. Achieving this growth also requires better capital allocation and stronger fiscal coordination between the central and state governments.

Data & Insights.title: Net direct tax collections rise 13% to  ₹12.1 trillion
Data & Insights.summary: Net direct tax collections increased by 13% to reach ₹12.1 trillion. Meanwhile, net corporate tax collections grew by 19.48% after accounting for refunds.

India.title: Ahead Of Smog Season, Bhagwant Mann Defends Punjab Farmers, Takes Dig At Pakistan
India.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann has supported farmers' demands for a Rs 3,000 per acre cash incentive to manage paddy stubble ahead of the smog season. During his remarks, he also criticized Pakistan regarding the regional air pollution issue.

India.title: Rape Case Against Akali Dal Leader Amarjit Singh Chawla Latest Flashpoint In Punjab Politics
India.summary: An Akali Dal leader, Amarjit Singh Chawla, is facing a rape case in Punjab politics. A woman from Sangrur currently living in Bahrain has alleged she was held captive and raped at an Anandpur Sahib serai.

India.title: 5,053-Page Chargesheet Filed In Ketan Agarwal Murder Case
India.summary: Pune Rural police filed a 5,053-page chargesheet in the Vadgaon Maval court for the Ketan Agarwal murder case. The document includes witness statements, mobile data, call records, messages, and photos as evidence.

India.title: Helps Make Quicker Diagnosis: Apollo Hospitals Founder On AI In Healthcare
India.summary: Apollo Hospitals founder Dr. Prathap Reddy stated that artificial intelligence helps physicians make quicker medical diagnoses. He cited the hospital group's new ZAP-X system as a practical example of this modern medical technology.

India.title: Analysis: As Punjab Rehab Numbers Increase, Politics Intensifies Over Drug Problem
India.summary: The opposition has criticized the AAP government's "Yudh Nasheyan Virudh" campaign in Punjab as a publicity failure. Meanwhile, the government defends its efforts by highlighting increased drug seizures, higher conviction rates, and a growing number of de-addiction centers.

India.title: Higher education council holds talks with Indo-German centre official
India.summary: The higher education council met with an Indo-German centre official to discuss academic partnerships. They explored ways to strengthen institutional linkages between universities in Keralam and Germany.

General.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
General.summary: Denmark and the United States reached an agreement regarding Greenland following months of annexation threats from Donald Trump. Nato welcomed the deal, which Trump stated will grant the U.S. permanent security control of the territory.

General.title: Major seaside hotel fire treated as suspicious
General.summary: About 280 people were evacuated from the premises at Folkestone's Grand Burstin Hotel.

General.title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi capital after smoke seen rising near Riyadh airport
General.summary: Houthi rebels claimed responsibility for an attack near the King Khalid International Airport in the Saudi capital of Riyadh. The incident caused hours of flight disruptions amid an escalating conflict in Yemen.

General.title: Davey says Lib Dems are 'firewall against Farage' as conference begins
General.summary: At the party conference, Liberal Democrat leader Ed Davey stated that his party acts as a firewall against Nigel Farage. He also claimed the Lib Dems aim to surpass their record of 72 MPs in the event of a snap election.

General.title: Watch: Earl Spencer says he is telling the truth about a phone call with Charles after Diana's death
General.summary: Earl Spencer told the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg that his written claims about a phone call with King Charles after Diana's death are true. The interview follows the release of his new book detailing the post-death conversation.

General.title: Bitter row over Diana book brings back unhappy times for royals
General.summary: A bitter dispute over a new book about Princess Diana is reviving unhappy memories for the Royal Family. Many of the royals' current problems stem from the aftermath of her death.
